text:
alex: Heads-up — product ask from Acme: want a hard SLA for private pilot (99.9% p99 < 250ms) and deterministic onramp schedule. Asking for timeline by EOW.
maria: thanks alex. we need runtime + infra + security signoff. acme will require HSM-backed KMS + private VPC.
devon: pinging runtime. p99 250ms is tight for large-context chat model w/ current batch settings. we can try burst prewarm + smaller batch window.
sasha: security note: HSM lead time ~3 weeks for certing; addition of KMS integration needs SOC checklist filled.
elena: infra: we can reserve dedicated capacity, but autoscale and burst prewarm behaviour needs explicit runbook and budget approval. cost bump expected.
alex: can we sketch minimal launch criteria so customer knows what we can commit? i.e., must-have vs nice-to-have.
devon: propose must-have: dedicated pool in region, KMS integration (not HSM) for pilot, canary rollout with fallback to hosted model. nice-to-have: HSM, strict 99.9 SLA before GA.
maria: product asks: acme insists on HSM. negotiate: offer pilot with KMS and a committed plan to HSM in N+4 weeks after pilot acceptance.
sasha: security: KMS-only pilot ok if we get signed risk acceptance doc and limited dataset scopes. send me the risk form and i'll fast-track.
elena: infra: i'll create a capacity reservation PR with cost estimate. devon, pls confirm whether prewarm + smaller batches gets you to ~260ms p99 in staging.
devon: quick perf test plan: run 1k synthetic sessions w/ 8k tokens, profile with batching=auto small-window and prefix cache enabled. expected staging p99 ~270-320ms. if we enable KV cache warmup + burst nodes we might hit ~250-260ms.
alex: ok — tradeoffs are clear. maria i'll draft customer-facing commitment: pilot SLA target p99 < 300ms, KMS-based encryption, HSM roadmap + timeline. include rollback criteria and cost delta.
maria: draft would help. include explicit fallback: if p99 > 350ms during pilot, route critical traffic to hosted region and pause new tenant signups.
elena: noted. also need an ops playbook for circuit breaker: thresholds, who paged, and auto-scaling knobs. ops-bot: create incident template?
ops-bot: created incident-template "pilot-circuit-breaker" at https://redwood.internal/incidents/pt-1828881234 (auto).
sasha: i'll need to review customer data retention terms; send me the pilot contract excerpt.
maria: will attach contract draft in a follow-up thread. timeline check: infra + runtime can prepare staging by 2 weeks, security 3 weeks for KMS-only acceptance. is that acceptable for acme?
alex: customer asked for EOW response. we'll propose the staged commitment: partial SLA for pilot, clear HSM timeline, and rollback/fallback mechanics. ask legal to expedite contract review.
devon: one more tech note: to hit p99 target in GA we should plan quantized model variant for dedicated pools. add model-ops task for quantization experiments.
maria: added quantization to the product backlog under initiative "acme-private-onramp".
elena: i'll add capacity PR + cost delta to the same initiative board.
sasha: once contract is attached i'll sign off on risk for KMS pilot. HSM will need separate SOC attestation.
alex: thanks team. next steps: maria draft customer response today; elena open capacity PR; devon run perf experiments and post numbers; sasha assemble risk form. we'll reconvene async and then short sync if needed. :thumbsup:
maria: sounds good. thanks all.
